name: Kwame Silva
headline: Frontend Engineer
summary: Frontend engineer with a track record of building polished product experiences across fast-moving teams. Experienced in shipping user-facing features, improving reliability, and working closely with designers and backend partners to deliver measurable outcomes. Comfortable turning product requirements into maintainable interfaces and practical test coverage.
